name: ETA Generic (MIB)
description: Auto-compiled with libsmi from 1 MIB module(s). 152 readable OIDs under 1.3.6.1.4.1.44086.

oids.name: snmpTrapsEnable
oids.description: If 1 sending of SNMP traps is enabled. Else no traps will be sent

oids.name: snmpTrapTarget
oids.description: Traps are sent to the destination given here. This could be an IP address or a host name.

oids.name: snmpProtocol
oids.description: SNMP protocol version currently used. The value can only be changed using the SSH configuration.

oids.name: snmpCommunityString
oids.description: SNMP community string used to access the values. Also the SNMP traps are sent using this community string. Only valid if SNMPv2c is used.

oids.name: snmpLogin
oids.description: Login name used to access the SNMP data values. Only valid if SNMPv3 is used.

oids.name: snmpPassword
oids.description: Password used to access the SNMP data values. The password have to be at least eight characters long. Only valid if SNMPv3 is used.

oids.name: snmpAuthentication
oids.description: Authentication method used to encrypt the SNMP data transmission. Valid entries are 'MD5' and 'SHA'. Only valid if SNMPv3 is used.

oids.name: snmpEncryption
oids.description: Encryption method used for the SNMP data transmission. Valid entries are 'AES', 'DES' and 'off'. Only valid if SNMPv3 is used.

oids.name: snmpEncryptionKey
oids.description: Encryption key used for the SNMP data transmission. Only valid if SNMPv3 is used.

oids.name: dhcpv4Enable
oids.description: If 1 the IPv4 settings are automatically obtained using DHCP.

oids.name: ip4Address
oids.description: IPv4 adress of the RCI10, for example 192.168.1.25.

oids.name: ip4NetMask
oids.description: IPv4 network mask, for example 255.255.255.0.

oids.name: ip4Gateway
oids.description: IPv4 gateway address, for example 192.168.1.1.

oids.name: dhcpv6Enable
oids.description: If 1 the IPv6 settings are automatically obtained using DHCP.

oids.name: ip6Address
oids.description: IPv6 adress of the RCI10, for example 2001:0db8:85a3::1000.

oids.name: ip6PrefixLength
oids.description: IPv6 network prefix length. Valid range is from 1 to 128.

oids.name: dnsServer
oids.description: Address of DNS server, for example 192.168.0.1. The address given here can be either an IPv4 or an IPv6 address.

oids.name: time
oids.description: Current system time. Write to this object to update the system time, use the format HH:MM:SS.

oids.name: date
oids.description: Current date of the RCI10. Write to this object to update the system date, use the format dd.mm.yyyy.

oids.name: timezone
oids.description: Timezone of the RCI10. The timezone gives the difference between UTC and local time in hours.

oids.name: dstEn
oids.description: If 1 the daylight saving time is enabled.

oids.name: hwVersion
oids.description: RCI10 hardware version

oids.name: hwSerial
oids.description: RCI10 hardware serial number

oids.name: swVersion
oids.description: RCI10 software version

oids.name: systemName
oids.description: RCI10 System Name

oids.name: systemContact
oids.description: Name of the person which is responsible for the system

oids.name: systemLocation
oids.description: Location of this RCI10

oids.name: reboot
oids.description: Write 1 to this value will cause a reboot of the RCI10.
